dashboard.body: This is your dashboard. Choose the **Customise** gear beside the greeting to arrange it: move or remove widgets where they stand, choose **Add Widget** for more, and **Done** to keep the layout.

dashboardWidget.body: Choose **Customise**, then **Add Widget**, pick **Warranties expiring soon** and choose **Done**. It lists the next warranties to expire, and its title opens the Warranties page.
